exam_scheme.note: Telangana State Teacher Eligibility Test (TG TET) is conducted by the Department of School Education, Government of Telangana in accordance with NCTE guidelines and G.O. Ms. No. 36 (2015), G.O. Ms. No. 8 (2022), G.O. Ms. No. 18 (2024), and G.O. Ms. No. 28 (2025). The test is conducted as a Computer Based Test (CBT) across two sessions per day. Paper I is for candidates intending to teach Classes I to V (Primary), and Paper II is for Classes VI to VIII (Upper Primary/Elementary). Each paper consists of 150 multiple-choice questions (MCQs) carrying 1 mark each with no negative marking, and has a duration of 2 hours and 30 minutes (150 minutes). Qualifying mark is 60% (90/150) for General/EWS, 50% (75/150) for BCs, and 40% (60/150) for SC/ST/Differently-abled. A pass in TET carries a lifetime validity, and score weightage of 20% is assigned in Telangana Teacher Recruitment Tests (DSC / TRT).
